title: THE IRAN–IRAQ WAR, 1980–1988
visual_policy: Original historical sources only. Preserve full image/document boundaries. No AI historical images, generated battlefield footage or social-media interface.
narrative_policy: Iraqi and Iranian contemporaneous correspondence is party testimony, not an independent factual verdict.

inputs.usage: Internal leads only. Locate and verify underlying original documents; do not show intermediary social-media authors, screenshots or interfaces.
No claims or visuals from inaccessible thread may be used until retrieved and checked.

inputs.title: UN Security Council Resolution 479
inputs.claim: Called on Iran and Iraq to refrain immediately from further use of force and seek mediation.

inputs.title: UN Secretary-General report S/14205
inputs.claim: Recorded an Iraqi response dated September 29 and expected formal Iranian response soon afterward.

inputs.title: Iran letter S/14206
inputs.claim: Iran alleged Iraqi incursions and support for Iranian counter-revolutionary activity.
inputs.caveat: The letter contains claims made by the Iranian government.

inputs.title: Iraq letter S/15826
inputs.claim: Iraq alleged Iranian artillery attacks preceding its September 1980 offensive.
inputs.caveat: The letter contains claims made by the Iraqi government.

inputs.title: UN Security Council Resolution 598
inputs.claim: Demanded a ceasefire and withdrawal of forces.

inputs.title: UN Peacemaker — implementation of Resolution 598
inputs.claim: Iran formally accepted on July 17, 1988 and Iraq reaffirmed acceptance the next day.

Precise number of prewar border violations
